beats.text: This template shows the building blocks of every video in this style: three-dimensional scenes with real light, reflections and glow.
Exact diagrams come from TikZ and are drawn step by step, while every formula is typeset with LaTeX.
Plots, labels and subtitles share the same colours and fonts, so every new video looks like part of one series.
Surfaces, glowing curves and free camera paths are flexible building blocks.
Every scene can reshape them, or add its own three-dimensional ideas.
